sloka: ह्रियमाणौ तु काकुत्स्थौ दृष्ट्वा सीता रघूत्तमौ  ।उच्चैः स्वरेण चुक्रोश प्रगृह्य सु महाभुजौ  ॥३-४-१॥
transliteration: hriyamāṇau tu kākutsthau dṛṣṭvā sītā raghūttamau  ।uccaiḥ svareṇa cukrośa pragṛhya su mahābhujau  ॥3-4-1॥

translations.english: Seeing those two mightyarmed Rama and Lakshmana being carried away by Viradha, Sita started crying loudly:
